title: The module $\mathcal{O}_X(D)$ of an effective Cartier divisor
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme and let $D\subset S$ be a closed subscheme whose ideal sheaf $\mathcal{I}_D$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], locally generated by a non-zero-divisor. Such a $D$ is an *effective Cartier divisor* on $S$. Its ideal sheaf is invertible by [lemma-nagata-effective-cartier-is-invertible], and the *associated invertible module* is its dual [def-sc-invertible-module]:

$$
\mathcal{O}_S(D):=\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal{O}_S}(\mathcal{I}_D,\mathcal{O}_S)=\mathcal{I}_D^\vee .
$$
